[[File:Baggoth's Rampart.png|thumb|300px|Baggoth's Rampart, with the [[Banner of Baggoth]] flying atop the central tower.]]
'''Baggoth's Rampart''' is a dwarven fortification located in the [[Grim Reaches]]. Built by Commander [[Baggoth Ironmantle]], Marshal of Dun Kithas,<ref>[[Historian Sternhand#Quotes]]</ref> it was overrun by [[orc]]s of the [[Dragonmaw clan]] when they rose once more against the [[Wildhammer dwarves]] of the Reaches. In the chaos of the attack, the dwarven defenders were forced to leave behind the [[Banner of Baggoth]], the standard of the Wildhammer people.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|33|The Dragonmaw War (3)|The Dragonmaw War}}</ref>
